svg.title: A crackly line, still on the phone
svg.desc: A simple hand-drawn picture in two panels. Above the left panel it says "old build": the handset of the phone on the table dangles by its cord, and a person in a blue T-shirt has crossed the arms and turned away from it, while the screen on the table still says "connected". Above the right panel it says "v18": the same person keeps the phone at the ear, with zigzag lines for static around it; the bubble says "Bad line, but I'm still here.".
